thread.title: Stocks Hold Solid Gains, As Top IPO Plunges On Weak Sales Guidance

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stocks Hold Solid Gains, As Top IPO Plunges On Weak Sales Guidance
text:
The major market averages looked to rebound from Wednesday's bearish reversal with solid gains early Thursday, but top new issue Roku ( ROKU ) plunged in the stock market today .
X The S&P 500 and Dow Jones industrials moved up 0.6% apiece, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq followed up with a 0.5% rise.
Meanwhile, Bitcoin continued its volatile ways, as it declined almost 5% to fall back under $10,000, according to CoinDesk .
Within the Dow industrials — of which most were trading in positive territory — Apple ( AAPL ) advanced more than 1%, as it clings to its 50-day line support level. The stock has been recovering strongly since Feb. 9 and is only 4% away from a new high, though a new base has yet to form.
Elsewhere, Caterpillar ( CAT ) rose nearly 2%, but is still stuck below its 50-day line. The stock will need to reclaim that level before building the right side of a potential base.
FANG stocks looked to snap back from Wednesday's market reversal, as Amazon.com ( AMZN ) led the way with a near 1% advance. The e-commerce giant hit a new high Wednesday. Facebook ( FB ) added 0.8%, but the social media giant remains stuck in neutral under its 50-day line.
